title: Snake Pattern Matrix Traversal
description:
Given an `m x n` integer `matrix`, return a 1D array of all elements visited in a horizontal snake (boustrophedon) pattern.

Traverse rows from top (`row = 0`) to bottom (`row = m - 1`). Even-indexed rows (`0, 2, 4, ...`) are read from left to right, and odd-indexed rows (`1, 3, 5, ...`) are read from right to left.
hints: Process each row independently from index 0 to m - 1.
Append row elements forward when row % 2 == 0 and in reverse when row % 2 == 1.

examples.explanation: Row 0 goes left-to-right [1, 2, 3], row 1 goes right-to-left [6, 5, 4], and row 2 goes left-to-right [7, 8, 9].
Row 0 yields [10, 20] and row 1 reversed yields [40, 30].
A single column visits every row from top to bottom regardless of direction.
